about.title: Digital solutions that serve organisations
about.intro: TSD Systems designs and sells digital solutions for schools, businesses and agricultural value chains.
about.mission1: Give organisations simple, reliable tools to run their day-to-day activity: less paper, fewer scattered files, up-to-date and shared information.
about.mission2: Our solutions are built for teams with little time to spend on IT: they must be clear from the very first use.

transparency.title: Transparency

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.description: How TSD Systems handles the information sent through the contact form.
privacyPage.intro: This page explains what information we receive through this website and how we use it.
privacyPage.dataText: The contact form collects your name, your email address and your message. No other personal information is requested.
privacyPage.ipText: To limit abuse, your IP address is turned into a non-reversible fingerprint; the address itself is not stored.
privacyPage.purposeText: This information is only used to reply to your message. It is never sold or used for advertising.
privacyPage.recipientsText: Your messages are read by the TSD Systems team. They are stored with our hosting provider and may pass through our email delivery provider so that we are notified of their arrival.
privacyPage.cookiesText: This website uses no analytics or advertising cookies. Only a technical cookie is set when an administrator signs in to the administration area.
privacyPage.rightsText: You can ask to access, correct or delete the information about you by writing to {email}.
